# Research data (generated by `scripts/export_results_data.py` — do not edit by hand)

Exported from `results/` at commit 1354a35. The result reports in `docs/v3/RESULTS_*.md` are computed from these files (simulation outputs; no API keys, raw model responses or images). Regenerate the derived tables with `make v3-report` and `python -m sfaic2.v3.supplement report`. Mode codes R0–R5 and metric names are defined in `sfaic2/v3/live_results.py` and `docs/v3/MODEL_ASSUMPTIONS.md`.

Rows with `decision_provider = MOCK_JEV` in `confirmatory/runs.csv` are a software check and are not evidence about the decision model; rows with `data_quality` other than `ok` are excluded from all statistics. Camera input derives from MVTec AD (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0); image ids are opaque hashes.
